verdict.rationale: The skill lifecycle has a programmatic path: custom skills can be uploaded and managed through the Skills API, and both pre-built and custom skills can be attached to Messages API requests via the `container` parameter (up to 20 per request). The Agent SDK also lets sessions control, dispatch and author skills. However, no evidence shows that every UI action has an API equivalent: Claude.ai skill availability and plugin-marketplace install via `/plugin` slash commands are only documented as in-product flows. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, API equivalents for marketplace and plugin install, any documented Claude.ai skill-management parity, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API coverage.
